scripts.check: bunx prettier --check src scripts drizzle.config.ts && bun run typecheck && bun run src/cli.ts --help
scripts.db:generate: bunx drizzle-kit generate && bun run db:prepare
scripts.db:check: bunx drizzle-kit check && bun run scripts/check-migration-assets.ts
scripts.smoke:runtime:build-linux: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-linux-x64 --asset-naming='[dir]/[name].[ext]' --outfile dist/runtime-smoke/local-base-linux-x64 && bun build scripts/runtime-smoke.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/runtime-smoke/runtime-smoke-linux-x64
